set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Profiles identify dominant kernels and allocations at representative sizes.
- Optimized exact/entropic paths preserve differential and invariant tolerances.
- Asymmetry, starts, and mixed precision do not regress.
- Canonical benchmarks show material improvement or a documented floor.
- PR/nightly thresholds guard the result.
set.title: Optimize semi-relaxed GW and FGW hot paths
